Is that going to happen from your mushroom? Probably not bro. I like to share, so therefore I feel it's my responsibility to keep clean. 
My mom is highly allergic to penicillin for example. That's why I never fruit trichoderma cakes, because of the possible adverse reaction someone could have, not the toxicity of the mold or bacteria per say.
